# ARVAELLE

> ARVAELLE is a Dubai-based online jewellery brand selling minimal gold-plated necklaces and gift sets. Every piece arrives in a signature black ARVAELLE gift box with a handwritten card. Orders are placed on WhatsApp (+971 54 178 7801) and delivered across Dubai, same day for orders paid before 2 pm.

## Products
- The Solstice Necklace: gold-plated rectangular pendant with a starburst motif and a single stone. AED 249.
- The Eternal Loop Necklace: gold-plated sculptural loop pendant with a polished finish. AED 229.
- The Duo Gift Set: both necklaces together in two gift boxes. AED 429.

## Ordering and delivery
- Order on WhatsApp; payment by secure link (Apple Pay, Visa, Mastercard, Aani).
- Dubai delivery AED 25, free over AED 400. Same-day if paid before 2 pm.
- 7-day exchange for unworn pieces in original packaging.
